title: Uncertainty-aware AI-enabled framework for predicting hydrogen dispersion in confined spaces to enhance operator situational awareness
abstract: arXiv:2610.23515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a two-stage AI-enabled framework for enhancing operator situational awareness during compressed hydrogen bunkering in maritime confined spaces. In the event of a leak, the framework first estimates the unknown leakage rate from early sensor readings and then forecasts how the hydrogen cloud will disperse over the next time steps, providing operators with a predicted concentration map together with confidence bounds. The framework is based on two independent AI models building one AI system. The AI system is designed as a decision-support tool. It augments sensor readings, and thus enhances operator situational awareness and supports decision-making. This enables preventive safety barriers to be deployed before hazardous concentrations are reached, while an independent emergency shutdown system remains the ultimate safety layer. The system design incorporates safeguards to ensure the AI system operates within its competence env

translated_title: 面向受限空间氢气扩散预测的不确定性感知人工智能框架，以提升操作员态势感知能力
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个两阶段AI赋能框架，用于增强船舶受限空间中压缩氢气加注作业期间操作员的态势感知能力。在发生泄漏事件时，该框架首先根据早期传感器读数估计未知的泄漏速率，然后预测氢气云团在未来时间段内的扩散情况，为操作员提供带有置信区间的浓度预测图。该框架基于两个独立的AI模型构建为一个AI系统。该AI系统被设计为决策支持工具，它对传感器读数进行增强，从而提升操作员的态势感知能力并支持决策制定。这使得在危险浓度达到之前就能部署预防性安全屏障，而独立的紧急停机系统仍作为最终的安全保障层。系统设计中包含了保障措施，以确保AI系统在其能力范围内运行。
tldr: 该论文提出一个两阶段不确定性感知AI框架，通过从早期传感器读数估计氢气泄漏速率并预测氢气云团扩散（附带置信区间），为船舶受限空间加注作业中的操作员提供浓度预测图，增强态势感知并支持预防性安全决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware two-stage AI framework that estimates hydrogen leak rates from early sensor readings and forecasts hydrogen cloud dispersion with confidence bounds, providing operators with predicted concentration maps to enhance situational awareness and enable preventive safety measures during maritime hydrogen bunkering in confined spaces.
